question: Can a fully funded BTC spot-long/perpetual-short book earn positive net cash flow after both legs' costs without an observed collateral shortfall?
input_qualification_scope: pre-return correctness revision: require verified fill and daily NAV quotes and funding mark minutes; retain unused archive defects; never impute missing mark minutes; incomplete stress hours remain unknown and fail feasibility
observed_mark_repair_rule: only missing monthly mark observations from official daily archives; checksum, same-day OHLC/calendar and identical overlap required; never interpolate; any remaining held-hour gap stays unknown and fails feasibility

mechanism.sizing: equal BTC units spot long and perpetual short; solve entry fees so residual USDT collateral equals spot purchase cost; no borrowing or interest
mechanism.clock: calendar-month full close/reopen at 01:00 UTC on day 1 plus delay_days; reject funding in any possible trade hour; final flatten at 2026-08-31 23:00 UTC
mechanism.funding: signed realized rate times held units times settlement-minute mark open as proxy; previous/current minute lows/highs bound the mark and signed payment; no predicted funding gate
mechanism.collateral: separate USDT wallet; conservative hourly-high stress, charge all negative hour funding before stress and credit positives after; 5% maintenance proxy plus exit-fee reserve; historical venue margin tiers and liquidation fills unqualified
mechanism.ablation: hedge_no_funding removes all funding receipts/payments, retains each leg, collateral, gross monthly closing costs and clock
mechanism.episodes: closed monthly paired holdings, net of both legs' entry and exit fees; censored holdings never wins; cash has zero closed episodes and null win rate

feasibility_gate: all four candidate cells have positive net CAGR and positive funding-lower-bound closed wealth, all held hours have complete observed mark-minute stress coverage and no conservative collateral breach; this is not the C60 three-objective gate
selection: cashflow diagnostic line; intrinsically incomparable to unchanged G20/C60 protocols and ineligible for their ranking even if feasibility passes
stop: one frozen candidate and two controls, all 12 curves; no threshold, funding window, topup ratio, event clock or cost rescue after returns
limitations: archive retrieval is not contemporaneous publication vintage
minute mark range is not an exact exchange funding receipt
hourly trade opens are synchronized price proxies, not atomic executable quotes
5% maintenance stress does not certify historical venue liquidation safety
USDT/USD conversion, custody, ADL, insolvency and transfer outages unmodeled; no USDT interest assumed
no independent OOS or production promotion
